name: Budget Pro 2026 — Personal Finance Command Center
target_buyer: 25-40yo professional, post-Mint/YNAB, wants ownership and customization
promise: 12 sheets that show you exactly where your money went, where it's going, and how to hit your goals.
self_promotion_angle: Buyers post net worth charts, debt payoff celebrations, savings milestone screenshots.
v1_remaining_work: Run scripts/assemble.ps1 (or follow scripts/assemble-gsheets.md manually) to produce budget-pro-2026.xlsx with 12 tabs — 2 min for PowerShell, 15 min for manual GSheets

Apply conditional formatting from dashboards-design.md to the Dashboard, Budget vs Actual, and Net Worth tabs in the live .xlsx (1-2 hours — formulas are in formulas-reference.md, but the spec describes ranges, not exact rule assignments)
Insert 6 charts from dashboards-design.md into the Dashboard tab (Category Spend pie, Income vs Expense bars, Net Worth line, etc.) — 45 min
Generate 1 cover PNG (1600x2000) from cover-prompt.md — 30 min
Generate 3 mockup PNGs (Dashboard, Net Worth, Goals) from mockup-prompts.md in order 1-2-3 — 45 min
Apply mobile-friendly tab color-coding from setup-guide.md — 10 min
Validate the live .xlsx opens cleanly in Google Sheets (upload to Drive, open, check formulas resolve) — 5 min
Package into budget-pro-2026-v1.zip with the .xlsx + setup-guide.pdf + bonus CSV imports — 5 min

blockers: PowerShell path to ImportExcel module must be set up; or operator can ship as Google Sheets PDF only
build_to_revenue_path.shipping_tip: The 12 CSVs are the deliverable — you can ship on Gumroad today by zipping the CSVs with the setup-guide and a one-line 'import these to Google Sheets' note. The .xlsx is the bonus that takes 2 minutes to assemble once PowerShell is set up.
